name: Offline PCAP Viewer & Packet Analyzer
desc: Open a libpcap .pcap capture in your browser and dissect Ethernet, VLAN, IPv4/IPv6, TCP, UDP, ICMP and ARP, with filtering, a hex view and JSON export. Nothing uploaded.

name: PE & ELF Header Viewer
desc: Inspect Windows PE (.exe, .dll, .sys) and Linux ELF binary headers, architecture, entry point and section table in your browser. Static parsing only, nothing uploaded.

name: Windows Registry Hive Viewer
desc: Open a Windows Registry hive (NTUSER.DAT, SYSTEM, SOFTWARE, SAM) or a .reg export in your browser, browse the key tree, read values, filter and export to JSON/CSV. Nothing uploaded.

name: SQLite Database Viewer
desc: Open a SQLite database (.db, .sqlite, .sqlite3) in your browser: browse tables, read the schema, run SQL and export CSV. Runs on sql.js (WebAssembly); your file is not uploaded.

name: Binary Strings Extractor
desc: Extract printable ASCII and UTF-16LE strings from a binary, executable or firmware image in your browser. Min-length, offsets, URL/IP/path/email filters. Nothing uploaded.

name: SVG Sanitizer
desc: Clean an SVG in your browser: remove script and foreignObject, on* event handlers, javascript:/data: URIs and DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations, with an audit log. Nothing uploaded.

name: WebAssembly Disassembler & Bytecode Inspector
desc: Disassemble WebAssembly binaries (.wasm) to WebAssembly Text (WAT), inspect section headers, audit imports and exports, and analyze bytecode instructions locally in browser RAM. 100% offline, zero network egress.
